backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing civic complaint system with user profiles, role-based access control, complaint management (CRUD operations with status tracking), media uploads, and location-based features using Motoko with MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including role-based authentication, image/video upload with location tagging, helpline integration, complaint status tracking, and associated files/components with test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React files including App.tsx with routing, language context, hooks for queries and geolocation, layout components, auth components, and all page components for the civic complaint application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, and sidebar components using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for CivicGuard AI application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with 10 routes (Dashboard, FileComplaint, MyComplaints, ComplaintDetail, Volunteer, Profile, Education, Settings, RTI, ImpactProof), QueryClient, InternetIdentity, Theme, and Language providers with ProfileSetupModal and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using InternetIdentity with authentication state management, query cache clearing on logout, and error handling for duplicate authentication attempts.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup collecting name and role (Citizen/Authority/Admin) with form validation, displayed only when authenticated user has no profile and actor is ready.
frontend/src/components/complaints/Compl: Badge component displaying complaint status (received, underReview, actionTaken, escalated) with localized labels and variant styling (secondary, default, outline, destructive).
Displays a vertical timeline of complaint status history with dots and connecting lines, showing translated status labels for each entry.
Provides a status update UI for Authority/Admin users to change complaint status via dropdown and submit button, with toast notifications for success/error.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AreaCi: Displays civic scores (cleanliness and discipline) for multiple areas using progress bars with hardcoded sample data.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/CivicH: Placeholder component for a civic heatmap visualization, currently showing a muted box with placeholder text.
frontend/src/components/education/DailyF: Displays a daily civic fact in a card, fetched from a utility function based on current language.
frontend/src/components/education/DailyQ: Interactive quiz component with multiple-choice questions, score tracking, and navigation through questions with final score display.
frontend/src/components/education/DailyS: Displays a daily civic story with title, content, and moral in a card format, fetched based on current language.
frontend/src/components/education/Motiva: Placeholder component for motivational videos section, currently showing a 'no data' message.
frontend/src/components/gamification/Bad: Displays a grid of three badge levels with images, showing earned badges in full opacity and locked badges dimmed.
frontend/src/components/gamification/Civ: Shows user's civic score as a number and progress bar, capped at 100%.
frontend/src/components/gamification/Lea: Tabbed leaderboard component with city and school views, currently showing placeholder 'no data' messages.
frontend/src/components/helpline/Helplin: Displays emergency helpline numbers (112, 1969, 103) in color-coded cards with phone icons and labels.
frontend/src/components/impact/BeforeAft: Placeholder component for before/after comparison visualization, currently showing 'no data' message.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout wrapper with header, footer, and outlet for nested routes in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component displaying copyright year, app name, and attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Sticky header with logo, desktop navigation menu, login button, and mobile menu sheet trigger.
frontend/src/components/layout/MobileNav: Mobile navigation drawer with icon-labeled links to all major app sections, closing drawer on navigation.
frontend/src/components/reporting/Anonym: Switch component for toggling anonymous reporting mode with label and description text.
frontend/src/components/reporting/ImageU: File input wrapper for uploading images, creating blob URLs with geolocation metadata and passing Media objects to parent callback.
frontend/src/components/reporting/IssueT: Grid of clickable issue type cards (garbage, tobacco, traffic, nuisance) with icons, highlighting selected type.
frontend/src/components/reporting/Tobacc: Displays a tobacco awareness card with an icon, alert message, and a statistics counter (currently showing 0) using translated text from the language context.
frontend/src/components/reporting/VideoU: Provides a video upload component that validates video duration (30-90 seconds), captures geolocation, creates a blob URL, and passes the media object to a callback handler.
frontend/src/components/rti/RTIGenerator: Renders a simple card component displaying a 'no data' message using translated text from the language context.
frontend/src/components/settings/Languag: Provides a language selection dropdown that allows users to switch between English and Hindi, persisting the choice via the LanguageContext.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Creates a React context for managing language state (English/Hindi) with localStorage persistence and provides a translation function that retrieves localized strings.
frontend/src/data/civicFacts.ts: Exports arrays of civic awareness facts in English and Hindi covering topics like waste management, pollution, traffic safety, and community health.
frontend/src/data/moralStories.ts: Defines moral story data structures and exports bilingual (English/Hindi) stories about civic responsibility with titles, content, and moral lessons.
frontend/src/data/quizQuestions.ts: Exports quiz question data in English and Hindi with multiple-choice options and correct answers covering civic awareness topics like waste management, emergency numbers, and public hygiene.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializes access control with an admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Custom hook that retrieves the user's current geolocation coordinates using the browser's Geolocation API and manages loading and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flows, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for backend operations including user profile management, complaint filing/retrieval/updates, and media uploads, all using the actor from useActor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components (primary, secondary, muted, destructive, etc.) and chart colors.
frontend/src/locales/en.ts: English translation strings for the entire application, covering navigation, authentication, complaint filing, status tracking, education, gamification, RTI generation, and impact proof features.
frontend/src/locales/hi.ts: Hindi translation strings for the application, providing localized versions of all UI text including navigation, complaints, education, volunteer tasks, and civic features.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/ComplaintDetail.tsx: Displays detailed information about a specific complaint including issue type, description, media, status timeline, and provides status update functionality for authorities.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing hero banner, helpline panel, daily civic fact, issue heatmap, and area civic scores in a grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/Education.tsx: Education hub with tabbed interface for daily quiz, facts, stories, motivational videos, and tobacco awareness content to promote civic learning.
frontend/src/pages/FileComplaint.tsx: Complaint filing form that collects issue type, description, media uploads, geolocation, and anonymous reporting preference before submitting to backend.
frontend/src/pages/ImpactProof.tsx: Page for displaying before/after comparison of resolved civic issues to demonstrate community impact and action taken.
frontend/src/pages/MyComplaints.tsx: Displays a list of user's filed complaints with status badges, timestamps, and navigation to detail view; shows empty state with call-to-action when no complaints exist.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page displaying civic score, badge level, and leaderboard; fetches caller's user profile data and renders gamification components.
frontend/src/pages/RTIGenerator.tsx: Page wrapper for the RTI (Right to Information) generator component with localized title.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page containing language toggle component for switching between Hindi and English.
Volunteer marketplace page with placeholder empty state; intended to display available civic tasks for volunteers.
frontend/src/utils/dailyFactSelection.ts: Selects a daily civic fact based on day of year, cycling through English or Hindi fact arrays deterministically.
frontend/src/utils/dailyQuizSelection.ts: Selects 5 daily quiz questions deterministically based on day of year from English or Hindi question pools.
frontend/src/utils/dailyStorySelection.t: Selects a daily moral story based on day of year, cycling through English or Hindi story arrays deterministically.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended animations, typography plugin, and design tokens for a dark-themed civic app UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining CivicGuard AI as a full-stack civic tech platform with AI-powered complaint reporting, gamification, multi-language support, and extensive feature list including authentication, media uploads, privacy tools, and educational content.
